decisions.reason: The organic sliced salami platter sits squarely within the firm's curing and slicing know-how and its strategic organic expansion, and its continued presence over two years shows the firm can read its sales signals and has chosen to retain it.

The premium sharing salami snack builds directly on core salami expertise and was extended with a poultry variant in 2024, signalling that management interpreted early results positively and is building on them, though snack formats carry turnover risk as seen with Product B.
Organic Fleischwurst is a classic boiled-sausage staple where the firm's traditional processing knowledge transfers fully into the organic line, making it easy to assimilate and refine.

Thinly sliced organic chicken breast with two flavour variants extends the firm's poultry and slicing capabilities into a growing ingredient-conscious segment, and as a fresh 2024 launch it deserves more time before its results can be judged.
The organic herb-coated salami relies on in-house seasoning and maturation expertise that the firm knows well, so it is a low-risk variant that fits the organic growth strategy.
